scenarios.name: Extension upgrade and source table 53198
scenarios.expected: Upgrade preserves existing tables, creates evidence table, no removed fields or tables.

scenarios.name: Non-SUPER scan permissions
scenarios.expected: BCSENTINEL SCAN can scan without SUPER; VIEWER cannot modify evidence.

scenarios.name: Baseline duplicate customer VAT scan A
scenarios.expected: Two seeded Customer records sharing one test VAT; grouped finding affected_count=2; source evidence has two true Customer.SystemIds.

scenarios.name: Remediation and scan B
scenarios.expected: Changing one test Customer VAT removes the group; PASS with zero members; remaining legacy/other checks not individually compared.

scenarios.name: Backend sealed source record readback
scenarios.expected: Both accepted scan IDs bind to same tenant/company and stored canonical source evidence; hashes and lifecycle valid; no raw business values in payload.

scenarios.name: Retry and stale lease rejection
scenarios.expected: Exact retry idempotent; changed record members, omitted evidence, wrong worker or stale lease rejected.

scenarios.name: Negative scope and partial source coverage
scenarios.expected: Wrong company/tenant, interrupted scan and incomplete member count yield no falsely verified result.

scenarios.name: Boundary and monitoring/report safeguards
scenarios.expected: Over 2000 members omit optional record evidence and keep aggregate scan; Validation/Monitoring report unlock remains blocked.
